name: Generate images of mask overlaid on DWI
summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a brain mask overlaid on a DWI image with FSL slicer, to check brain extraction.
description: Runs FSL slicer with the DWI as background and the mask as overlay and writes raw/out.png. Use it to check that a DWI brain mask covers the brain; the DWI and mask must share the same voxel grid. It does not modify the data.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
inputs.requirements: Must be on the same voxel grid as the mask.

inputs.description: The path to the mask datatype containing the brainmask of the DWI

outputs.description: Directory with out.png showing the brain mask outline on the DWI.
